name: MCPJam
tagline: Open-source inspector to test, debug, and evaluate MCP servers and ChatGPT apps.
description: MCPJam is a local-first developer tool, a 'Postman for MCP', for testing, debugging, inspecting, and evaluating Model Context Protocol servers. You can manually run tools, resources, resource templates, prompts, and elicitation flows with full JSON-RPC observability, debug every message and OAuth exchange, and run evaluations across multiple LLMs to catch regressions. It runs as a hosted web app, a Mac/Windows desktop app, or via npx in your terminal.
insight: Open source under Apache-2.0; tests OpenAI's ChatGPT Apps (Apps SDK) alongside MCP servers, not just MCP alone.

modelSupport.notes: Test and eval across multiple LLM providers; free frontier-model chat or bring your own key.

edge: A visual 'Postman for MCP': run tools and inspect every JSON-RPC and OAuth exchange, then score servers with multi-LLM evals in one local UI.

references.title: Testing MCP servers with MCPJam Inspector
